repertoires.name: Colle 1 V3 - Mainlines & Core Structures
repertoires.description: The complete primary Colle-Koltanowski system. Features 5 core tactical/positional structures, strict decision rules, and the 9.b4 Phoenix secret weapon[cite: 1].

core_structures.name: Structure 1: Greek Gift (h7 Sacrifice)
core_structures.key_mechanic: Bxh7+ followed by Ng5+ and Qh5 to obliterate the enemy king[cite: 1].

core_structures.name: Structure 2: Rook Lift (e4 - Rxe4 - Rh4)
core_structures.key_mechanic: Mandatory when Black plays ...Nbd7. Recapture e4 with the Rook and swing to h4 for direct mating threats[cite: 1].

core_structures.name: Structure 3: e5 Wedge (Ne5 + f4 Stonewall Switch)
core_structures.key_mechanic: Triggered when Black plays ...b6 / ...Bb7. Plan A is blocked, switch to Plan B (The Stonewall) with Ne5, f4, and g-pawn storm[cite: 1].

core_structures.name: Structure 4: Isolated Queen's Pawn (IQP)
core_structures.key_mechanic: Arises in open central trades; leverage active piece dynamics and dark-squared bishop scope[cite: 1].

core_structures.name: Structure 5: Bishop Pair vs Space (Anti-Colle)
core_structures.key_mechanic: Target Black's early ...Bg4 with 4.h3 Bh5 5.g4 Bg6 6.Ne5 Nfd7 7.Nxg6 hxg6 8.c4 to grab the bishop pair[cite: 1].

decision_rules.rule: Do NOT play dxc5. Play 8.Re1, then 9.e4, and MANDATORY recapture with the Rook (12.Rxe4 -> Rh4)[cite: 1].
Plan A is blocked -> Switch to Plan B (The Stonewall): Ne5 + f4 + g-pawn storm[cite: 1].

decision_rules.trigger: Fork in the Road at Move 9 (after 8...Bxc5)
decision_rules.option_a: 9.e4 - Classic Koltanowski Attack system (ideal vs <1800 ELO or unprepared opponents)[cite: 1].
decision_rules.option_b: 9.b4 - The Phoenix (Reversed Semi-Slav with extra tempo; positional secret weapon against prepared players / 10...h6)[cite: 1].

decision_rules.rule: Directly challenge with 4.h3 Bh5 5.g4 Bg6 6.Ne5 Nfd7 7.Nxg6 hxg6 8.c4[cite: 1].

mainline_pgn_tree.name: Colle 1 Mainline vs 7...Nc6
mainline_pgn_tree.pgn: 1. d4 d5 2. Nf3 Nf6 3. e3 e6 4. Bd3 c5 5. c3 Nc6 6. Nbd2 Bd6 7. O-O O-O 8. dxc5 Bxc5 9. e4 Qc7 10. Qe2 Bd6 11. Re1 Ng4 12. h3 Nge5 13. Nxe5 Nxe5 14. Bc2 d4 15. f4 d3 16. Bxd3 Nxd3 17. Qxd3 Bxf4
mainline_pgn_tree.annotation: Standard 8.dxc5 transition leading to central initiative and king attack[cite: 1].

mainline_pgn_tree.name: Colle 1 Mainline vs 7...Nbd7 (The Rook Lift)
mainline_pgn_tree.pgn: 1. d4 d5 2. Nf3 Nf6 3. e3 e6 4. Bd3 c5 5. c3 Nbd7 6. Nbd2 Bd6 7. O-O O-O 8. Re1 e5 9. e4 cxd4 10. cxd4 exd4 11. e5 Nxe5 12. Rxe4!! dxe4 13. Rh4
mainline_pgn_tree.annotation: Crucial Rook recapture 12.Rxe4! swinging directly to h4 for decisive tactical play[cite: 1].

mainline_pgn_tree.name: The Phoenix Variation (9.b4 Secret Weapon)
mainline_pgn_tree.pgn: 1. d4 d5 2. Nf3 Nf6 3. e3 e6 4. Bd3 c5 5. c3 Nc6 6. Nbd2 Bd6 7. O-O O-O 8. dxc5 Bxc5 9. b4! Bd6 10. Bb2 a6 11. a3 b5 12. a4
mainline_pgn_tree.annotation: Reversed Semi-Slav with an extra tempo. Punishes Black's preparation and h6 prophylaxis[cite: 1].

repertoires.name: Colle 2 V3 - Sidelines & Anti-Systems
repertoires.description: Complete counter-strategies against every non-standard attempt by Black to disrupt the Colle System[cite: 1].

anti_systems.name: Baltic Defence (2...Bf5)
anti_systems.pgn: 1. d4 d5 2. Nf3 Bf5 3. c4 e6 4. Qb3 Nc6 5. c5 Rb8 6. Nc3
anti_systems.key_plan: Punish the early bishop walk by expanding with a b4-b5 pawn storm on the queenside[cite: 1].

anti_systems.name: Chigorin Defence (2...Nc6 3.e3 Bg4)
anti_systems.pgn: 1. d4 d5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. e3 Bg4 4. c4 e5 5. Qb3! Bxf3 6. gxf3
anti_systems.key_plan: Steinitz method: grab the bishop pair and exert heavy g-file pressure[cite: 1].

anti_systems.name: Early Central Counter (2...c5)
anti_systems.pgn: 1. d4 d5 2. Nf3 c5 3. dxc5 e6 4. e4 Bxc5 5. exd5
anti_systems.key_plan: Transpose into an advantageous Queen's Gambit Accepted structure with extra tempo[cite: 1].

anti_systems.name: Black Stonewall Setup (3...f5)
anti_systems.pgn: 1. d4 d5 2. Nf3 e6 3. e3 f5 4. Bd3 Nf6 5. O-O Bd6 6. c4 c6 7. b3 Qe7 8. Ba3!
anti_systems.key_plan: Force the crucial trade of dark-squared bishops via 7.b3 and 8.Ba3! (or 8.Bb2 / Qc1 if 7...Qe7) to neutralize Black's attack[cite: 1].

anti_systems.name: Reversed London System (3...Bf5)
anti_systems.pgn: 1. d4 d5 2. Nf3 Nf6 3. e3 Bf5 4. c4 c6 5. Nc3 e6 6. Nh4 Bg6 7. Nxg6 hxg6
anti_systems.key_plan: Neutralize Black's open h-file and maintain complete central mastery[cite: 1].

anti_systems.name: Kings Indian / Fianchetto Setup (3...g6)
anti_systems.pgn: 1. d4 d5 2. Nf3 Nf6 3. e3 g6 4. Bd3 Bg7 5. O-O O-O 6. Nbd2
anti_systems.key_plan: STRICT RULE: Do NOT play the Stonewall! Dominate the center via 4.Bd3, 5.O-O, and 6.Nbd2[cite: 1].

puzzles.explanation: Mandatory Rook recapture! 12.Rxe4! allows the Rook Lift to h4 for a winning king attack[cite: 1].
The Phoenix! 9.b4! gains queenside space and creates a reversed Semi-Slav with an extra tempo[cite: 1].
Neutralize Black's Stonewall by trading dark-squared bishops via 8.Ba3![cite: 1].
